title: Long-Standing Agreements: Months Off a Security Deposit Review Extension
content:
**Clause.** The service length of the secured Electric Service Agreement lowers the extension of the refund review date of a held Security Deposit whose satisfactory payment review is not passed: where the agreement has been in service for at least 120 whole months on the decision day, the day the review is decided, 2 months come off; where for at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months, 1 month comes off; otherwise nothing comes off.

**Counting.** Service length runs from the agreement's start date to the decision day. Whole months between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the same day of a later month, a month whose day has not yet been reached on the later date not counting.

| Whole months in service on the decision day | Months off the extension |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 2 |
| 60 to 119 | 1 |
| Fewer than 60 | Nothing |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Agreement start date | Decision day | Whole months in service | Months off |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 May 2016 | 15 May 2026 | 120 | 2 |
| 15 May 2016 | 14 May 2026 | 119 | 1 |
| 3 June 2021 | 3 June 2026 | 60 | 1 |
| 3 June 2021 | 2 June 2026 | 59 | Nothing |
